name: La Maupin to the rescue!
source:
Rescue your beloved girlfriend from the evil convent. Fight drunks, sneak around, fool people, set things on fire!
Based on the life of Julie d’Aubigny a.k.a La Maupin.

[From [url=https://rumpel.itch.io/la-maupin]itch.io[/url]]
translation:
从邪恶的修道院中救出你心爱的女朋友。与醉汉战斗、鬼鬼祟祟、愚弄他人、放火焚烧！
改编自朱莉·奥比尼（又名莫平）的一生。

[来自[url=https://rumpel.itch.io/la-maupin]itch.io[/url]]
